thread.title: Apple's stock surges again, as Apple retakes position as largest U.S. company by market cap - MarketWatch

author: Tomi Kilgore
title: Apple's stock surges again, as Apple retakes position as largest U.S. company by market cap - MarketWatch
text:
Shares of Apple Inc. AAPL, +1.90% ran up 1.8% in morning trade, enough to pace the Dow Jones Industrial Average's DJIA, +0.61% gainers, and to propel the technology giant back to Number One on the list of largest U.S. companies by market capitalization. The shares have now soared 12.7% amid a 5-session win streak that started after Apple reported fiscal first-quarter results after the Jan. 29 close. The stock is also now up 22.6% since it closed at a 20-month low opf $142.19 on Jan. 3. Apple's stock rally raises its market cap to $821.7 billion, above second-place Microsoft Corp. MSFT, +0.89% at $817.4 billion, and ahead of third-place Amazon.com Inc. AMZN, +1.74% at $815.1 billion. Google-parent Alphabet Inc.'s stock GOOGL, -1.07% fell 0.3% after the internet giant reported fourth-quarter results late Monday, putting the company's market cap in fourth place at $791.6 billion.
